attempts.exactPrompt:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Valel Iveran: 29-year-old woman, 179 cm (tall), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: broad oval face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; small upturned nose, heavy lower lip; one brow notch. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: brown-chestnut, medium-loose, deliberate accent: wrapped side section. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; offset closures and narrow reinforced cuffs; bounded palette plum-gray. Visible personal details: contrasting boot laces. Make unusual but bounded color blocking the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: ornate hair maintenance with plain clothing care. Color treatment: keeps color restrained to layered edges. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a polished seed case only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Exactly one anatomically coherent 29-year-old adult woman appears, with no duplicated body, limbs, hands, or facial anatomy.
The entire head and hair, seed-case palm, opposite hand, all mantle and divided layers, and both laced boots remain fully inside generous margins above a soft grounding shadow.
Broad visible brush planes, controlled illustrative skin and cloth detail, and parchment handling produce a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

The tall conditioned-athletic construction is unmistakable, and the broad oval adult face, asymmetric brows, broad cheek planes, small upturned nose, heavy lower lip, brow notch, chestnut medium-loose hair with wrapped side accent, plum-gray short mantle and divided layers, offset closures, narrow cuffs, restrained edge colors, mismatched contrasting boot laces, broad stance, upward palm, and polished seed case are legible; however, exposed skin reads medium-deep rather than the explicitly required unmistakable skin-value band-6 deepest.
The closed mouth and firm gaze remain calm and neutral, without a smile, grin, or theatrical acting.
The image remains ordinary mortal cloth and a small seed case with no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

Valel has a distinct broad face, side-swept partially wrapped hair, plum-gray short mantle, divided trouser silhouette, seed-case pose, and palette unlike the ochre-braid rendering reference; only the authorized painterly register and parchment composition carry over.
